groups.title: Employer FAQ Pages
groups.description: SEO- and AI-optimized FAQ pages on Built In that help employers answer the questions candidates ask before they apply, like what it's like to work there and whether employees recommend it.
groups.goal: Make each company's employer story easy to find in search and easy for AI assistants and answer engines to cite accurately, so candidates get a clear, credible answer at the moment they're deciding.
work: Structured each page around the real questions candidates search, such as whether a company is a good place to work.
Led every answer with a direct summary, then added scannable supporting points and a bottom line that search engines and AI tools can easily extract.
Balanced the content with candidate tradeoffs, employee perspectives and external signals, so the pages read as trustworthy rather than promotional.
Built each page as part of a connected FAQ set covering culture, career growth, compensation, work-life balance and more, linked together for discoverability.

companies.title: What's It Like to Work at MetLife?
companies.angle: Financial services at global scale, with a focus on purpose-driven work, internal mobility and employee-led innovation.

companies.title: What's It Like to Work at Spectrum?
companies.angle: A large connectivity company where the employee story centers on career growth, job stability, benefits and pay.

companies.title: What's It Like to Work at BAE Systems, Inc.?
companies.angle: Defense and aerospace careers framed around mission impact, stability, internal career tools and flexible schedules.

companies.title: What's It Like to Work at SharkNinja?
companies.angle: A fast-moving consumer products culture built on ownership, cross-functional teamwork and visible product impact.

groups.title: AI-Friendly Content Rewrites
groups.description: Existing Built In listicles restructured so search engines and AI assistants can pull out accurate, citable answers quickly.
groups.goal: Keep established pages visible as discovery shifts toward AI-generated answers, by making each page's key facts easy to find, extract and cite accurately.
work: Opened each piece with a concise summary that states the core takeaway, so AI tools can lift a direct answer.
Added a quick-scan list of headline companies near the top, giving readers and AI tools a fast index of the page.
Standardized every company profile with the same labeled fields, such as location, industry and services, plus a short description, so details are easy to extract.
Added linked, sourced statistics for context and, where it fit, a closing Q&A section built around the questions readers ask.
